definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two weeks. Used for schedules, publications, and recurring events.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{隔週|かくしゅう}で{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: Meetings are held every other week.

examples.japanese: {隔週|かくしゅう}の{金曜日|きんようび}にピアノのレッスンがある。
examples.english: I have piano lessons every other Friday.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{隔週|かくしゅう}で{発行|はっこう}されており、{次号|じごう}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{火曜日|かようび}に{届|とど}く{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: This magazine is published biweekly, and the next issue is scheduled to arrive next Tuesday.

notes:
USAGE:
{隔週|かくしゅう} uses the prefix {隔|かく} meaning "every other" or "alternate." It functions as a noun or adverbial modifier.

RELATED PATTERNS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう} (every other week)
- {隔月|かくげつ} (every other month)
- {隔日|かくじつ} (every other day)
- {隔年|かくねん} (every other year)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう}で (biweekly, every other week)
- {隔週|かくしゅう}{発行|はっこう} (biweekly publication)
- {隔週|かくしゅう}{刊|かん} (biweekly periodical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隔週|かくしゅう}: every other week (precise, specific interval)
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week, weekly
- {月|つき}に{二回|にかい}: twice a month (similar but not identical)
